overlayEntry.notes: Measured 2026-07-27; journaled at agents/safety-score-v9/data-coverage-wave8-2026-07-27/mech2-drafts/journals/2026-07-27-reusd-chainlink-reserves-feed.json. valuationCadenceDays is 1: the protocol documents a daily 00:00 UTC NAV recalculation, the app's embedded reUSD price series carries one dated point per day (latest 2026-07-27T00:00:00Z = 1.0915035634083883), the Ethereum NAV oracle's latestRoundData updatedAt is 2026-07-26T23:47:47Z, and the Chainlink offchain-reserves feed attested daily by The Network Firm read 179,147,152.27 at Avalanche block 91393580 with updatedAt 2026-07-27T18:10:09Z, exactly matching the dashboard's offchain-capital figure for 2026-07-27. weightedAverageMaturityDays is unavailable: the dashboard, docs, and the 2025-10-31 AUP report publish no per-asset tenor or WAM table; the offchain book is deployed into Principal-at-Risk Notes under a $100M program with a disclosed five-year term (matures 2031-04-02, rollover by mutual agreement up to five more years), but drawn vintages and weights and the tenor of the $318.93M premium receivables are not published, so no portfolio WAM can be computed without fabrication. Component grades under the D3 standard: creditQuality is weak on documented facts — the offchain instrument is an unsecured, limited-recourse obligation of a single Cayman segregated portfolio (Cover Re SPC SP1), subordinated to cedent and policyholder claims, with no cross-portfolio recourse and no guarantees. seniority is limited: reUSD is the documented last-loss senior tranche (reinsurer equity of $77M as of June 2026 and reUSDe absorb losses first), but the waterfall is issuer-published without a pinned enforceable filing. legalEnforceability is weak on documented facts: token holders have no direct legal claim on Regulation 114 trust assets; economic exposure runs only through the Note held in the Resilience Inv SPC structure, and the token issuer is an unregulated Cayman foundation. valuationCadence is adequate: dated independent attestation (The Network Firm AUP report as of 2025-10-31) plus an independently operated Chainlink feed updated daily, pinned on-chain today. maturityAndLiquidity is weak on documented structure: daily instant redemptions are capped (buffer above 1% of supply, 10% per-transaction and 20% daily caps, 0.06% fee) with a quarterly-queue fallback, while the principal offchain asset is a five-year note and uncollected premium receivables. custody is adequate: the named firm verifies custodial balances and ownership daily (published via Chainlink), onchain idle capital sweeps to named Fireblocks institutional vaults, and offchain capital sits in segregated Regulation 114 trust accounts. recovery is limited: a documented loss waterfall, CIMA-mandated coupon deferral gates, narrow emergency-pause criteria, and an onchain Surplus Note Registry exist, but there is no realized recovery evidence and no holder-direct claim on trust assets.

weightedAverageMaturityDays.rationale: Searched the Re transparency/metrics dashboards, the docs.re.xyz product and transparency pages, and the 2025-10-31 Network Firm AUP report: none publishes constituent maturities, vintage weights, or a portfolio WAM. The disclosed Principal-at-Risk Note program has a five-year term maturing 2031-04-02 with rollover options, but drawn amounts by vintage and premium-receivable tenors are undisclosed; the tenor table should live on the transparency dashboard alongside the itemized capital figures.

aupReport.title: Independent Accountant's Report on Agreed-Upon Procedures
aupReport.scope: In-scope assets held and the Re Protocol as of the snapshot; procedures covered supporting-asset listings, custodial arrangements, bank/brokerage account balances observed with management, Fireblocks MPC wallet observation, and onchain address queries; engagement by Resilience Foundation.

docsFacts.navCadence: reUSD's onchain price recalculates every day at 00:00 UTC; the NAV oracle is monotonic, daily upward moves capped at 20%/365, updated by a dedicated NAV updater role.
docsFacts.lossWaterfall: Underwriting losses are absorbed by (1) the reinsurer's own equity, the junior layer ($77M as of June 2026), then (2) reUSDe, then (3) reUSD last; stress-modeled probability of reUSD impairment at a 135% combined ratio approximately 0.03% (issuer modeling, November 2025 LP Memo).
docsFacts.redemptionGates: Instant redemptions while the onchain buffer holds more than 1% of total reUSD supply; no single redemption above 10% of the buffer; total instant redemptions capped at 20% of available redemption capacity per day; 0.06% redemption fee; quarterly queue when the buffer falls below 1%.
docsFacts.principalAtRiskNote: $100M program issued 2026-04-02 under Master Terms and Conditions, five-year term maturing 2031-04-02 with rollover by mutual agreement up to five additional years; coupon 30-day average SOFR plus 500 bps (M1) / 950 bps (M2) payable annually in arrears with CIMA-mandated solvency and collateral deferral gates; notes are unsecured, limited-recourse obligations of Cover Reinsurance SPC Ltd.'s SP1 only, no cross-portfolio recourse, no recourse to general assets, no guarantees, subordinated to cedent and policyholder claims, ranking ahead of equity distributions; token holders have no direct legal claim on Regulation 114 trust assets; CIMA approval received; drawdowns/repayments emitted onchain via the Surplus Note Registry.
docsFacts.custodyStructure: Onchain idle capital sweeps daily into Fireblocks institutional custody vaults under multisig policy; offchain deployed capital sits in Section 114 trust accounts, segregated bank accounts separate from the reinsurer's general assets; Cover Reinsurance SPC Ltd. is a CIMA-regulated Class B(iii) insurer acting for Segregated Portfolio #1; The Network Firm performs daily AUP attestations on offchain reserve balances and custody ownership, published via Chainlink oracles.
docsFacts.emergencyPause: Pause via Access Manager (MPC 5-of-8) and Redemptions Config (MPC 3-of-5); narrow trigger criteria (reserve-asset peg dislocation, oracle failure/manipulation, exploit, custody or counterparty compromise at Fireblocks or the §114 trust custodian, regulatory action, pipeline failure); unpause requires executive and risk approval plus a 48-hour delay.

evidenceSummary: Read the Chainlink Re Reserves feed (0xc79a363a3f849d8b3F6A1932f748eA9d4fB2f607) at Avalanche block 91393580 (2026-07-27T23:40:42Z) via public RPC: answer 179,147,152.26673412 USD (8 decimals), updatedAt 2026-07-27T18:10:09Z, exactly matching the Re transparency dashboard's offchain-capital figure embedded asOf 2026-07-27T23:37:31Z (onchain $75,539,681.13; premium receivables $318,925,958.48; total TVL $573,612,791.88). valuationCadenceDays=1 pinned by the documented daily 00:00 UTC NAV recalculation, the daily Ethereum NAV oracle update (updatedAt 2026-07-26T23:47:47Z at block 25627505), the daily Network Firm-attested Chainlink update, and the app's one-point-per-day reUSD price series (latest 2026-07-27 = 1.0915035634083883). weightedAverageMaturityDays is unavailable: no tenor/WAM table exists in the dashboard, docs, or the dated (2025-10-31) Network Firm AUP report; only the $100M Principal-at-Risk Note program's five-year term (matures 2031-04-02) is disclosed, without drawn vintages/weights. Components: valuationCadence and custody adequate (dated named-firm AUP + daily Chainlink publication + named Fireblocks/§114 trust custody); creditQuality, legalEnforceability, and maturityAndLiquidity weak on documented terms (unsecured limited-recourse subordinated note; no holder claim on trust assets; daily redemption caps vs five-year note book); seniority and recovery limited (documented waterfall and pause/deferral mechanics without enforceable filings or realized recovery).
